void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, section backgrounds, maximum-contrast surface

carbon.$description: Carbon — Navigation bar, elevated surface base, footer surface

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card surfaces, elevated panels, contained content blocks

iron.$description: Iron — Hairline borders, dividers, structural separators

chalk.$description: Chalk — Alternate light surface, inverted card context

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary headings, body text, icon strokes, button borders, link text — the single chromatic force in the system

signal-mint.$description: Signal Mint — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

the-future.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system — navigation, body, headings, buttons, and labels. The slight positive tracking (0.02–0.04em) at all sizes creates a measured, architectural quality uncommon in fintech.
